detail.longDescription:
Our favourite screen in PicnicTasks is the one with nothing on it:

"Nothing on the blanket. Enjoy the sunshine."

We're aware that "the best bit of our app is when you're not using it" is an unusual sales pitch. It's also the point. A to-do list is there to get things off your mind, not to become somewhere you live.

Here's to an empty blanket this weekend. 🐝

https://picnictasks.uk/app

#productivity #weekend
